title: How APIs Work: From Requests to Responses
summary: Learn what APIs are, how data travels across the web, and why modern applications depend on them. Fast, interactive, and code-free.

overview.about: Almost every app you use talks to other systems through APIs: weather, maps, mobile money. This short tutorial explains what an API is and how a request becomes a response, in plain words and with no code.
youWillLearn: What an API is, and why apps need one
The steps a request takes from your phone to a server and back
How to read common status codes such as 200 and 404

recap: An API is a controlled doorway between systems.
A request goes out, the server checks it and prepares an answer, and a response comes back.
Status codes tell you whether it worked.
actionPoints: Next time you check the weather or send money in an app, think about the API call behind it.
Look up the developer page of a service you use and see what it lets other apps do.
finish.nextSteps: Keep noticing APIs in the apps you use every day. If you want to build with them, a good next step is a no-code tool such as Zapier or Make, which connects two services without code.
